dict.string: Juno uses the microphone to transcribe your voice when you use the dictation shortcut or optional “Listen for Juno” wake mode. Wake mode keeps a lightweight on-device detector running only while enabled in Settings.
Juno needs Accessibility access to read the focused text field and insert dictated text into any app.

Juno may need access when your app copy or project folder lives under Documents so the local voice engine can start from that location. Your recordings and history stay in Library/Application Support/Juno.
Juno creates reminders you ask for by voice (e.g. "Juno, remind me to call Sam tomorrow at 9am"). You can revoke this anytime in System Settings.
